-- Read-only aggregate inventory for staging hlzqmreeoghbldnhlybr only.
-- No identifiers, emails, answers, request hashes, or tokens are returned.
BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s';
WITH
snapshot AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT statement_timestamp() AS at),
sessions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.session_status, s.lease_expires_at, s.started_at,
         a.activation_status, a.closes_at,
         coalesce(v.controls ->> 'lateSubmissions', 'not_allowed') AS late_policy,
         s.session_metadata ? 'pendingSubmission' AS has_pending,
         coalesce(s.session_metadata #>> '{pendingSubmission,requestHash}', '') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AS has_valid_pending_hash,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM examination_room_v1.submissions sub WHERE sub.session_id = s.id) AS has_submission,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM examination_room_v1.audit_events ae WHERE ae.session_id = s.id AND ae.event_type = 'student.submission_intent') AS has_intent_audit,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM examination_room_v1.audit_events ae WHERE ae.session_id = s.id AND ae.event_type = 'student.submit') AS has_submit_audit
  FROM examination_room_v1.student_sessions s
  JOIN examination_room_v1.room_activations a ON a.id = s.activation_id
  JOIN examination_room_v1.exam_versions v ON v.id = s.exam_version_id
),
duplicate_email AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT count(*) AS identities
  FROM examination_room_v1.student_identities
  WHERE identity_status = 'active' AND email_normalized IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY institution_id, lower(btrim(email_normalized))
  HAVING count(*) > 1
),
duplicate_room_email AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT count(*) AS attempts, count(DISTINCT er.student_identity_id) AS identities
  FROM examination_room_v1.student_sessions s
  JOIN examination_room_v1.exam_roster er ON er.id = s.roster_id
  JOIN examination_room_v1.student_identities si ON si.id = er.student_identity_id
  WHERE s.session_status IN ('created','active')
    AND si.email_normalized IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM examination_room_v1.submissions sub WHERE sub.session_id = s.id)
  GROUP BY s.activation_id, lower(btrim(si.email_normalized))
  HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT (SELECT at FROM snapshot) AS captured_at,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'total', count(*),
    'unfinished', count(*) FILTER (WHERE session_status IN ('created','active') AND NOT has_submission),
    'submitted', count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_submission),
    'revoked', count(*) FILTER (WHERE session_status = 'revoked'),
    'professor_review_open_lease_mismatch', count(*) FILTER (WHERE session_status IN ('created','active') AND NOT has_submission AND late_policy = 'professor_review' AND activation_status = 'open' AND closes_at > (SELECT at FROM snapshot) AND lease_expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM closes_at),
    'professor_review_open_expired_lease', count(*) FILTER (WHERE session_status IN ('created','active') AND NOT has_submission AND late_policy = 'professor_review' AND activation_status = 'open' AND closes_at > (SELECT at FROM snapshot) AND lease_expires_at <= (SELECT at FROM snapshot)),
    'strict_expired_lease', count(*) FILTER (WHERE session_status IN ('created','active') AND late_policy <> 'professor_review' AND lease_expires_at <= (SELECT at FROM snapshot)),
    'any_pending_metadata', count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_pending),
    'valid_pending_hash', count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_pending_hash),
    'revoked_with_pending', count(*) FILTER (WHERE session_status = 'revoked' AND has_pending),
    'expired_with_pending', count(*) FILTER (WHERE session_status = 'expired' AND has_pending),
    'intent_audit', count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_intent_audit),
    'submit_audit', count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_submit_audit),
    'intent_and_submit_audit', count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_intent_audit AND has_submit_audit)
  ) AS sessions,
  (SELECT jsonb_build_object('groups', count(*), 'identities', coalesce(sum(identities),0), 'largest_group', coalesce(max(identities),0)) FROM duplicate_email) AS active_duplicate_normalized_email,
  (SELECT jsonb_build_object('groups', count(*), 'attempts', coalesce(sum(attempts),0), 'identities', coalesce(sum(identities),0)) FROM duplicate_room_email) AS unfinished_duplicate_room_email,
  (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'rosters', count(*),
    'entered_number_differs', count(*) FILTER (WHERE er.accommodations ->> 'enteredStudentNumber' IS NOT NULL AND er.accommodations ->> 'enteredStudentNumber' IS DISTINCT FROM si.external_student_id),
    'email_external_identifier', count(*) FILTER (WHERE si.external_student_id LIKE 'EMAIL-%')
  ) FROM examination_room_v1.exam_roster er JOIN examination_room_v1.student_identities si ON si.id = er.student_identity_id) AS roster_number_mapping
FROM sessions;
COMMIT;
